units: pixels (x right, y DOWN) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.evidence: phase correlation of wall patch (x1250-1900, y80-700) vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.03 px in all frames (scene/tracks/camera.csv)
camera.view: frontal view of the rear of a box truck in a warehouse; image plane roughly parallel to the truck's rear face and to the box's front face
camera.perspective_cues: floor/wall boundary at y ~ 737 (approx. eye-level horizon is near y ~ 450-530: box underside visible while box is high, not visible at rest on roof at y 321-526); door frame sides converge slightly; tail-lift plate seen from above when horizontal

objects.name: cardboard_box
objects.description: brown cardboard box with one open lid flap sticking up at top-right; the only brown object in the scene
objects.reference_point: cx_ref_px, cy_ref_px = centre of the front face (proxy for the box origin/centre), y from template shift

pixel_size.notes: width constant to +-1 px during fall (2D motion, no depth change). Height: frame 0 face 61.7..257 = 195 px (underside visible below it to y 297); at rest face top ~321-326 (thin top/flap strip) to 526.4. Flap rises ~17 px above the face top.

objects.name: tail_lift_platform
objects.description: dark grey/black metal tail-lift (liftgate) plate at the bottom of the truck's rear door opening; rotates upward about a horizontal hinge at y ~ 1021-1027 to close against the door
objects.reference_point: no single visible centre: frames 0-58 plate is below the hinge (seen from above, near/free edge = near_edge_y_below_hinge, below image bottom in frames 0-3); edge-on at ~frame 58-59; frames 59-199 plate stands above hinge, free edge = upper_edge_y, hinge/bottom edge = lower_visible_y (~1026.5)

pixel_size.notes: plate still rising slightly at the last frame (0.0-0.6 px/frame), so 217.8 px is the near-upright projected length, a lower bound of the full plate length. Slight trapezoid shape (perspective of a tilted plate).

objects.name: truck_rear_body
objects.description: white box-truck body seen from behind, yellow reflective border, red/yellow hazard stripes at lower corners, 'DOLL' labels, red fire extinguisher at lower-left of door
objects.reliability: edges +-3 px (left edge mirrored from right edge 1227 about the centre x ~944; checked visually)

objects.name: rear_door_opening
objects.description: light-grey roller door inside a dark frame in the middle of the truck rear

objects.name: roof_rails
objects.description: two small metal rails/handles on the truck roof that the box lands on/between

objects.name: fire_extinguisher
objects.description: small red extinguisher on the truck rear left of the door

objects.name: warehouse_background
objects.description: grey panelled wall with horizontal panel seams (~70 px apart), vertical pillars at x ~ 445, 955, 1465; four ceiling lamps near y 40-80 (x ~ 110, 640, 1250, 1790); dark window/door panel at left x 0-195, y 65-730; grey floor below y ~ 737

events.event: box falling at start (released at or just before frame 0)
events.note: ref displacement 0.10 px at f1, 0.24 at f3, 1.8 at f5; motion is pure vertical (downward)

events.event: box first contact with truck roof/rails
events.note: cy_ref 402.1 (f58), 410.5 (f59), 419.1 (f60), f61 duplicate; bottom of mask reaches ~522-526 at f60-62

events.event: box max compression / lowest point after impact
tail-lift free edge enters image bottom
tail-lift plate edge-on (passes the viewing ray; free edge crosses the hinge line)
events.note: near edge 1025 at f58; upper edge starts rising above 1020.4 at f59

events.event: tail-lift still closing at video end (decelerating)

caveats: Box track has frozen (repeated) positions at frames 2, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 35, 37, 40, 47, 61, 63 (68, 69 at rest): the simulation output did not update the box on those frames while the tail lift kept moving. Per-frame differences are therefore jumpy; fit over several frames.
Box reference y uses the front-face template shift; the face-top edge track gives ~5 px less total drop (259.5 vs 264.4) because a thin strip of the top face/flap becomes visible near rest.
